# Morphine Test Fixtures

This directory holds test files for the Morphine Rust backend's conversion modules.

## Required Fixture Files

To run cargo tests successfully, please place valid binary sample files at these paths:

1. `sample.docx`: A minimal valid Microsoft Word Document (.docx) file.
2. `sample.pdf`: A minimal valid Portable Document Format (.pdf) file.

These files are ignored by git to keep repository footprint small.
